messages:
Priya (Docs): Quick sync 0: I'm prepping a small doc patch for Dedicated provisioning: a couple of broken anchors, an outdated autoscale YAML example, and the TypeScript SDK snippet that still shows the old API. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4690
Nikhil (ENG): can you list which parts are stale?
Priya (Docs): autoscale example uses `scalePolicy` and `tenant_id`. New schema is `scale_policies` (list) and `tenant_label`. TS snippet shows `createDedicatedPool` which is replaced by `reserveCapacity` returning `{ poolId }`. Also the SLA sentence is ambiguous about cross-region failover.
Hannah (Infra): dropping a compact YAML we prefer for the handbook (short):
Hannah (Infra): ```yaml
annotations:
  redwood.com/isolation: "reserved-pool"
scale_policies:
  - name: default
    min_replicas: 2
    max_replicas: 12
```
Omar (ML): content note: quantization tips reference an old model family. Suggest a 1-liner: "Use per-workload quant profiles and validate with a perf/quality sweep before applying cluster-wide."
Priya (Docs): good. Also proposing SLA wording tweak: current: "99.95% uptime for reserved pools." Suggest: "99.95% availability for in-region reserved capacity; cross-region failover may have different recovery characteristics." Thoughts?
Nikhil (ENG): add a short example below the SLA: "If region A has a zonal outage, traffic will failover to region B only if cross-region routing is configured; this is not covered by the in-region SLA." Keeps expectations clear.
Hannah (Infra): can we also include a tiny eviction precedence bullet? e.g., "reserved pools: prioritized, not preempted by shared; burst/shared: potentially preempted under pressure."
Priya (Docs): will add a 2-bullet list and link to runbook. Hannah, paste canonical runbook link?
Hannah (Infra): internal runbook: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/isolation-handbook (internal)
Priya (Docs): TS SDK snippet update I'll include:
Priya (Docs): ```ts
// new API: reserveCapacity returns { poolId }
const { poolId } = await client.reserveCapacity({ tenant_label: "team-payments", capacity: 6 });
console.log(poolId);
```
Nikhil (ENG): tiny ask: keep examples <35 lines in the handbook and link to a longer appendix for rationale.
Omar (ML): +1, and add one sentence about cache vs KV effects on tail latency under "performance notes".
ci-bot: docs-link-check: passed on branch priya/dedicated-provisioning-fixes :white_check_mark:
Priya (Docs): plan: push changes: 1) fix anchors, 2) swap yaml snippet, 3) update TS snippet, 4) SLA rewording + example, 5) eviction bullets + runbook link, 6) replace deprecated quant paragraph. I'll open PR later today and ping reviewers. :rocket:
